title: ARC_PRODUCED_COMMIT edge wiring
wanted_capability: Arc runner should write the producing commit SHA in `on_arc_exit` and emit an `ARC_PRODUCED_COMMIT` edge. Currently advertised in schema as a ghost edge (per design/commit-work-provenance.md Phase 0).
notes: Design called for arcs to record their producing commit SHA in `on_arc_exit`; not yet wired. M2-M5 arcs could populate.
